name: benethos-yahoo-finance-mcp
description: Unofficial read-only MCP server exposing Yahoo Finance data (via yfinance) over stdio or HTTP.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Yahoo Finance by company name, ticker symbol, or ISIN.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Get the current price and key intraday figures for a Yahoo symbol.

tools.name: get_quotes
tools.description: Get compact current quotes for several Yahoo symbols in one call.

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: Get historical OHLCV (open/high/low/close/volume) data for a symbol.

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Get a company profile and key statistics for a Yahoo symbol.

tools.name: get_financials
tools.description: Get a financial statement for a Yahoo symbol.

tools.name: get_dividends
tools.description: Get the dividend and stock-split history for a Yahoo symbol.

tools.name: get_news
tools.description: Get recent news headlines for a Yahoo symbol (up to limit, 1-10).

tools.name: get_calendar
tools.description: Get upcoming corporate-calendar events for a Yahoo symbol.

tools.name: get_shares
tools.description: Get the shares-outstanding history for a Yahoo symbol.

tools.name: get_recommendations
tools.description: Get analyst recommendation trends and price targets for a Yahoo symbol.

tools.name: get_earnings
tools.description: Get upcoming and historical earnings for a Yahoo symbol.

tools.name: get_estimates
tools.description: Get forward analyst estimates for a Yahoo symbol.

tools.name: get_upgrades_downgrades
tools.description: Get recent analyst rating changes (upgrades/downgrades) for a Yahoo symbol.

tools.name: get_holders
tools.description: Get the ownership breakdown for a Yahoo symbol.

tools.name: get_insider_activity
tools.description: Get insider trading activity for a Yahoo symbol.

tools.name: get_sec_filings
tools.description: Get recent SEC filings for a Yahoo symbol.

tools.name: get_options
tools.description: Get the option chain for a Yahoo symbol.

tools.name: get_fund_data
tools.description: Get fund/ETF profile data for a Yahoo symbol.

tools.name: get_sector
tools.description: Browse a market sector by its Yahoo key (not a ticker symbol).

tools.name: get_industry
tools.description: Browse an industry by its Yahoo key (not a ticker symbol).

tools.name: get_market
tools.description: Get the trading status and headline index summary for a market.

tools.name: screen
tools.description: Find stocks by criteria, e.g. dividend payers in a region or cheap large caps.
